zip_caveats: 80110 and 80113 also cover Sheridan, Cherry Hills Village, Greenwood Village and unincorporated Arapahoe County, each with different city measures (Sheridan 2D, Cherry Hills 2C). 80111, 80112, 80120, 80121 and 80122 are 'Englewood' mailing addresses that are actually Centennial, Littleton, Greenwood Village or unincorporated county. All of Englewood is in Congressional District 6 and State House District 3 (Census district maps, checked Oct 17). Englewood's State Senate seat (District 26) and RTD seat (District D) are not up this year, and Englewood is not in Arapahoe commissioner District 2 or 4, the only commissioner seats on the 2026 ballot. Every Englewood voter sees the Arapahoe County races (clerk, treasurer, assessor, sheriff, coroner) and the 18th Judicial District and Arapahoe County Court judges. Englewood voters are in the Front Range rail district only if their address is inside the district; Arapahoe County ballots wrongly printed 7A for some voters outside it, and clerks will sort that out. No Englewood city measures were found on the Arapahoe County list for 2026.
